scenario: a misunderstanding or problem involving public transport
english_title: Recognising and Responding to a Misunderstanding or Problem Involving Public Transport
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: public transport — a misunderstanding or problem involving public transport
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to a misunderstanding or problem involving public transport; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan asks Ms Sarah if this is the wrong bus.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan hỏi chị Sarah xem có phải đây là nhầm xe buýt không.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Excuse me, Sarah. Is this the wrong bus?
turns.vietnamese: Xin lỗi chị Sarah. Có phải đây là nhầm xe buýt không?

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Oh no. Thank you for telling me.
turns.vietnamese: Ôi không. Cảm ơn chị đã báo cho tôi.
